posts.cooked:
I really hesitate to bring this up, but doesn't Motley Crue play the top card of the villain deck?  Oh I see it, you've got it listed in End of Turn, but should check whether it alters the outcome any to have Temporal Thief happen before end of turn effects.

I'll get back to you with what La Capitan steals from Legacy.  It's a Take Down.

"Alright young lady, I have had ENOUGH of this!" Pauline bellows to La Capitan, in her best impression of the voice her old man used on her, during her mercifully short-lived "teenage rebellion" phase (thank God that she didn't develop most of her superpowers until after Daddy had talked - and occasionally, very gently, knocked - some sense into her still-hardening head.  "We will not tolerate any more of this aggression!  You are outside your native time and thus unprotected by the laws of any existing nation.  As enemy combatants, your actions can carry only one response."  With that, she focused her atomizing gaze on the armored, bespectacled Italian, the most obviously belligerent of Maria Helena's surviving subordinates, and with another "SHRAAAAAK!" reduced him to a cloud of sparkling carbon dust.
